{{Quote|Summon a medical team from ''Steadfast.''|[[Darth Malgus]] summoning an Imperial medical transport|<ref name="The Old Republic: Deceived">''[[The Old Republic: Deceived]]''</ref>}}
The '''Imperial medical transport''' was a class of [[transport]] used by the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]] around the time of the [[Sacking of Coruscant|sacking]] of [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]].

==Description==
The Imperial medical transport had a belly door and carried members of the [[Imperial Medical Corps]]. It also carried medical supplies and [[medical droid]]s.

==History==
One of these [[transport]]s, the [[Steadfast (Sith Empire)|''Steadfast'']], was used to pick up the wounded and dead Imperials after the [[Sacking of Coruscant]]. It also took the [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] [[Eleena Daru]] at the command of [[Darth Malgus]], even though she was [[alien]].
